title: In G4KLX DStarGateway and F4FXL DStarGateway before 7b75de6, dstarCallsignToAPRS in APRSUtils.cpp has an integer…
description: An integer underflow vulnerability exists in the dstarCallsignToAPRS function within APRSUtils.cpp in G4KLX DStarGateway and F4FXL DStarGateway before commit 7b75de6. This occurs via an empty RS-MS1A sender field. The vulnerability has a critical severity with a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2.
